title: VNCHIP Orientation 2026: Policy-Driven Development of Vietnam’s Semiconductor Industry – Insights from Dr.Huynh Phuoc Nghia
summary: Vietnam's semiconductor industry is at a pivotal crossroads. Transitioning from an emerging player to a critical global hub requires more than just ambition—it demands a robust, strategically integrated national policy framework.
content:
Vietnam's semiconductor industry is at a pivotal crossroads. Transitioning from an emerging player to a critical global hub requires more than just ambition—it demands a robust, strategically integrated national policy framework.

At the VNCHIP Orientation 2026: Nurturing Talent - Shaping the Future event, hosted at the University of Economics Ho Chi Minh City (UEH), attendees gained a macroscopic view of this trajectory from Dr. Huỳnh Phuoc Nghia. Serving as the Director of the Center for Economics, Law and Management at UEH and the Chief Strategy Officer of VNCHIP Technology JSC, Dr. Nghia delivered a profound analysis of how government policy is actively shaping the future of microchips in Vietnam.

Key Insights:

Perhaps the most powerful paradigm shift Dr. Nghia highlighted is the redefined role of human capital. In Vietnam's current economic narrative, the workforce is no longer viewed merely as a supportive element; instead, local talent is positioned as the primary national competitive advantage to attract global investment and climb the value chain.

For the emerging engineers and innovators in the audience, this translates to immense opportunity. The national blueprint explicitly relies on a "Human Capital First" approach. Students are not just preparing for jobs; they are the strategic core of Vietnam's ultimate formula for success: "Talent & Design + FDI Leverage + Gradual Value Chain Upgrade".

Dr. Nghia's session perfectly anchored the core mission of VNCHIP Orientation 2026. By understanding these high-level policy orientations, Vietnam's next generation of tech leaders is perfectly equipped to align their careers with the nation's ambitious semiconductor roadmap.

title: VNCHIP Orientation 2026: How Cadence is Applying Generative AI in Chip Design
summary: Artificial intelligence is no longer a distant concept, it is actively reshaping how semiconductor engineering is done today. As the industry faces increasing pressure to meet stringent PPA targets and accelerate system verification at advanced nodes, traditional design methodologies are rapidly evolving.
content:
Artificial intelligence is no longer a distant concept, it is actively reshaping how semiconductor engineering is done today. As the industry faces increasing pressure to meet stringent PPA targets and accelerate system verification at advanced nodes, traditional design methodologies are rapidly evolving.

At VNCHIP Orientation 2026: Nurturing Talent – Shaping the Future, participants had the opportunity to gain valuable insights from Ms. Tran Thuy Vy, Senior Principal Application Engineer and VN Site Leader at Cadence. Her session explored how AI is transforming engineering design workflows and redefining the role of engineers in the semiconductor industry.

One of the most compelling themes was the journey toward design autonomy. Chip design is no longer limited to manual optimization, it is progressing toward Level 5 autonomy, where AI-powered “virtual engineers” can seamlessly collaborate with human teams. This shift is not only changing how designs are created but also how engineers think and solve problems.

AI-driven solutions are already delivering remarkable results. From achieving up to 10x faster debug cycles to enabling 20x improvements in regression performance, AI is unlocking unprecedented levels of productivity across the design flow.

A standout highlight was the introduction of Agentic AI, particularly tools like the ChipStack AI Super Agent. By leveraging multi-step reasoning, these systems can autonomously generate and verify designs directly from high-level specifications—bringing the vision of fully assisted design closer to reality.

“The future of IC design lies not in replacing engineers, but in empowering them to work alongside intelligent systems.”

For students and aspiring engineers, the message was clear: mastering technical fundamentals is no longer enough. The next generation of talent must be ready to collaborate with AI-whether in writing RTL, developing testbenches, or debugging complex systems.

Ms. Vy’s session perfectly reflected the forward-looking spirit of VNCHIP Orientation 2026. As the semiconductor industry enters an AI-driven era, those who adapt early will be best positioned to shape the future.

Stay tuned for more highlights from our distinguished speakers at VNCHIP Orientation 2026.

title: VNCHIP Launches Talent Program 2025 with a Power-Packed Orientation Day
summary: FOR IMMEDIATE RELEASEHo Chi Minh City, Vietnam – April 21, 2025The energy was electric at VNCHIP’s Talent Program 2025 Orientation Day, as nearly 100 of Vietnam’s brightest 4th-year university students gathered to kickstart their journey in Integr...
content:
FOR IMMEDIATE RELEASEHo Chi Minh City, Vietnam – April 21, 2025

The energy was electric at VNCHIP’s Talent Program 2025 Orientation Day, as nearly 100 of Vietnam’s brightest 4th-year university students gathered to kickstart their journey in Integrated Circuit (IC) Design — one of the nation’s top-priority industries.

Held at the vibrant campus of the University of Economics Ho Chi Minh City (UEH), the event marked the official start of the VNCHIP Talent Program 2025 — an elite training initiative offering $2,000 scholarships to 40 selected participants. With mentorship from leading engineers, access to Vietnam’s first Cadence Certified Lab, and hands-on IC projects, these future innovators are ready to rise.

What Happened at Orientation Day?

The orientation event was a celebration of knowledge, ambition, and Vietnam’s growing potential in high-tech chip design. As students stepped into the world of silicon and simulation, they also became part of a broader vision — building Vietnam’s semiconductor ecosystem, one chip at a time.

About VNCHIP Talent Program
The VNCHIP Talent Program is a flagship training and scholarship initiative by VNCHIP Institute, aiming to empower Vietnamese students in IC Design through world-class tools, hands-on experience, and mentorship by top engineers.
About VNCHIP Institute
VNCHIP Institute is a leading research and education center dedicated to integrated circuit design and semiconductor innovation. As the first Cadence Certified Lab in Vietnam, VNCHIP provides advanced training, cutting-edge design services, and acts as a catalyst for high-tech talent development and industry-academic collaboration.

title: VNCHIP Institute’s Grand Opening Featured on HTV9 National Television
summary: Vietnam’s First Cadence Certified Lab Marks a New Milestone in IC Design InnovationHo Chi Minh City, Vietnam – June 5, 2025 – VNCHIP Institute is proud to announce that its Grand Opening Ceremony, held on April 24, 2025, was featured on HTV9 – Nat...
content:
Vietnam’s First Cadence Certified Lab Marks a New Milestone in IC Design Innovation

Ho Chi Minh City, Vietnam – June 5, 2025 – VNCHIP Institute is proud to announce that its Grand Opening Ceremony, held on April 24, 2025, was featured on HTV9 – National Television of Vietnam. The broadcast spotlighted VNCHIP’s landmark achievement as Vietnam’s first Cadence Certified Lab, positioning the Institute at the forefront of the country’s semiconductor development.

The Grand Opening celebration marked the launch of VNCHIP’s mission to become a central hub for integrated circuit (IC) design research, training, and production in Vietnam. In strategic partnership with Cadence Design Systems, VNCHIP aims to cultivate top-tier talent and deliver end-to-end semiconductor solutions.

“VNCHIP Institute aims to become a central hub for top talents in the semiconductor industry. We are committed to supporting both domestic and international organizations by providing comprehensive chip solutions—from research to practical implementation,” said the CEO of VNCHIP Institute.

This vision aligns with the national strategy to promote Vietnam as an emerging player in the global semiconductor supply chain. The feature on HTV9 included behind-the-scenes footage of VNCHIP’s state-of-the-art labs, expert interviews, and strategic insight into how VNCHIP and Cadence are working together to bridge academic research with real-world application.

VNCHIP’s role as a certified Cadence Lab not only enhances Vietnam’s engineering education landscape but also creates opportunities for domestic and international collaboration in high-tech R&D and IC design services.

title: VNCHIP Talent Program 2024
summary: On October 5th, 2024, we were thrilled to present certificates to all the amazing 3rd- and 4th-year university students who successfully completed our VNCHIP Talent Program after 4 months of hard work and dedication.This marks an important milesto...
content:
On October 5th, 2024, we were thrilled to present certificates to all the amazing 3rd- and 4th-year university students who successfully completed our VNCHIP Talent Program after 4 months of hard work and dedication.

This marks an important milestone in VNCHIP Talent Development efforts. From May 18th to Sept. 27th, VNCHIP Talent Program trained over 36 students from top HCMC universities (HCMUT, VGU, VNU-HCM, HCMUTE, HCMUS, UIT, International University - IU), and 18 of them successfully completed the course, earning their certificates. 🙌 The event ended with a delightful finger food party and a reflective sharing session, where we discussed the students' experiences and growth throughout the program. 🚀

A huge thank you to all our VNCHIPers for their support and expertise in IC Design, and congratulations once again to the participants for their outstanding achievements! VNCHIP are excited to continue empowering the next generation of engineers. 🎓
